class.name: AudioStreamPlaybackPlaylist
class.description: Playback component of [AudioStreamPlaylist]. Handles the playback of multiple [AudioStream]s in sequence.

method.name: get_current_index
method.description: Returns the index in [member AudioStreamPlaylist.streams] of the track that is playing, or [code]-1[/code] when the playback is stopped or has ended. The value is updated once per mix block and can be read from any thread without a lock.

method.name: get_current_stream
method.description: Returns the stream of the track that is playing, or [code]null[/code] when the playback is stopped.

method.name: get_position_in_playlist
method.description: Returns the position in seconds since the start of the playlist, in the current play order (the shuffled order if [member AudioStreamPlaylist.shuffle] is on): the start of the current track plus [method get_position_in_stream]. Updated once per mix block.

method.name: get_position_in_stream
method.description: Returns the position in seconds inside the current track (not inside the whole playlist, see [method AudioStreamPlayback.get_playback_position]). Updated once per mix block.
